description_en: Cancels URL upload tasks that are in the queue
description_zh: 取消排队中的URL上传任务
name: CancelUrlUploadJobs

parameters.help_en:
The list of task IDs. You can obtain the task ID (JobId) from the PlayInfo struct returned by the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/56124.html operation.
A maximum of 10 IDs are supported.
Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

You must specify either JobIds or UploadUrls. If both are specified, only JobIds is processed
parameters.help_zh:
任务ID列表，任务ID（JobId）可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/56124.html接口中返回的PlayInfo结构体中获取。
最多支持10个ID。
多个ID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。

JobIds和UploadUrls必须指定一个，二者同时传入时只处理JobIds
parameters.name: job_ids

parameters.help_en:
The list of source video upload URLs. Separate multiple URLs with commas (,). A maximum of 10 URLs are supported.

URL-encode the URLs before use.
You must specify either JobIds or UploadUrls. If both are specified, only JobIds is processed
parameters.help_zh:
上传源视频URL列表。多个URL之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔，最多支持10个。

使用前，先进行URL编码。
JobIds和UploadUrls必须指定一个，二者同时传入时只处理JobIds
parameters.name: upload_urls

CanceledJobs.description_en: The list of tasks that were successfully canceled

items.description_en: The list of tasks that were successfully canceled. The return values are JobIds
items.description_zh: 取消成功的任务列表。返回值为JobId

NonExists.description_en: The list of tasks that do not exist

items.description_en:
The list of JobIds or URLs that do not exist.

If the request parameter is JobIds, the return values are JobIds. If the request parameter is UploadURLs, the return values are URLs
items.description_zh:
不存在的JobId或URL列表。

如果请求参数为JobIds，返回值为JobId；如果请求参数为UploadURLs，返回值为URL
